title: 第733章 上古大妖传承第732章 万年木精
slug: 人在合欢宗开局成为圣女道侣
content_zh:
那道沧桑的声音，
来得快，去得也快，如同一阵清风拂过。
陆尘浑身一震，
那一瞬间，
他仿佛看到无穷无尽的画面碎片在眼前飞速掠过。
古战场……
血与火……
断剑与残旗……
一双双决绝的眼睛，还有那位中年男子举剑问天的背影……
可那些画面还未等他细细辨认，便又如潮水般退去。
陆尘隐约记得，
在那片飞速掠过的画面碎片之中，
那一座座被火光吞噬的巨城，
城墙之上，爬满了焦黑的人族尸骸。
城墙下，
堆积着断裂的法器和残破的旌旗。
一位位身形高大的异族踏火而行，有的周身神力翻涌，有的妖气冲天、面目狰狞，还有的魔气缠绕，更有的如同从深渊中爬出来的恶鬼……
他们之间的争斗，从不曾问过人族的意愿。
神魔之战，天崩地裂，
可那些倾泻而下的神通术法、那些被踏碎的城池山河，却都落在了人族的头顶。

屠戮、焚烧、践踏……
不分修士和凡人，不论老幼和妇孺。
他们从不顾及人族的无辜。
惨叫声淹没天地，一道道神魂灵光接连熄灭。
而那位举剑问天的中年男子，
还有他身后那支衣衫褴褛的残军，却是这片焦土之上唯一还在反抗的脊梁。
陆尘站在这片万年前的废墟幻象之中，
亲眼看着那些异族践踏属于人族的土地，看着那些同族被碾碎如尘埃。
那一瞬，
一股滔天怒意自他胸中轰然涌起！
他感同身受，
仿佛亲眼目睹了那场惨烈，那场不公！
“凭什么？！”
陆尘心中嘶吼：
“凭什么神魔高高在上，便可随意决定人族的生死？！
凭什么我人族之土，要任由异族践踏？！
凭什么那些无辜之人，连逃都来不及便要灰飞烟灭？！”
他体内沉寂许久的杀戮煞气，
在这一刻被那满腔怒火猝然点燃，轰然炸开！
下一瞬，

画面骤然消失，
煞气翻涌间，
那道苍老的声音在他脑海中一遍遍回响：
content_en:
That vicissitudes of voice,
As quickly as it came, it went as quickly as a breeze.
Lu Chen was shocked all over,
At that moment,
He seemed to see endless fragments of images passing quickly before his eyes.
Ancient battlefield...
Blood and fire...
Broken sword and broken flag...
A pair of determined eyes, and the back of the middle-aged man raising his sword to ask the sky...
But before he could carefully identify those images, they receded like the tide.
Lu Chen vaguely remembered,
Among the fragments of images passing by quickly,
The huge cities that were devoured by fire,
The city wall was covered with charred human corpses.
Under the city wall,
There were piles of broken instruments and broken flags.
One by one, tall aliens walked on the fire, some with divine power surging around their bodies, some with demonic aura soaring into the sky and ferocious faces, others entangled with demonic aura, and some even looking like evil ghosts crawling out of the abyss...
The fight between them never asked the wishes of the human race.
The battle between gods and demons, the sky collapsed and the earth shattered,
But those magical powers that poured down and the cities, mountains and rivers that were trampled to pieces all fell on top of the human race.
Slaughter, burn, trample...
There is no distinction between monks and mortals, young and old, women and children.
They never care about the innocence of humans.
The screams drowned the world, and the spiritual lights of the gods were extinguished one after another.
And the middle-aged man who raised his sword to ask the sky,
And the ragged remnant army behind him was the only backbone still resisting in this scorched earth.
Lu Chen stood in the illusion of ruins thousands of years ago,
Seeing with my own eyes those alien races trampling on the land that belongs to the human race, and watching those of my own race being crushed into dust.
At that moment,
A surge of overwhelming anger surged from his chest!
He felt the same way,
It was as if I had witnessed that tragedy and injustice with my own eyes!
"Why?!"
Chase Lu roared in his heart:
"Why are gods and demons so high above us that they can decide the life and death of the human race at will?!
Why should our human race’s land be trampled upon by foreign races? !
Why should those innocent people be wiped out before they even had time to escape? ! "
The murderous evil spirit that had been dormant in his body for a long time,
At this moment, he was suddenly ignited by the anger and exploded!
The next moment,
The screen suddenly disappeared,
When the evil spirit surges,
That old voice echoed over and over again in his mind:
